meta.title: Sustainability | Paperboard packaging & FSC — Saladín Industria Gráfica
meta.description: Paperboard is the renewable, recyclable alternative to plastic. FSC certification in progress (expected 2026) to support exporting brands with responsible packaging.

hero.title: Paperboard is the future of packaging
hero.subtitle: Renewable, recyclable and biodegradable: paperboard packaging is the real alternative to single-use plastic — and the one export markets already demand.

sections.title: FSC certification in progress
sections.text: We are in the FSC certification process, expected for 2026, to offer verified chain of custody for the paper and board we use.

sections.title: Paperboard vs. plastic
sections.text: Migrating packaging from plastic to folding cartons or litho-laminated board reduces end-of-life impact and communicates your brand's commitment on the shelf.

sections.title: Built for exporters
sections.text: North American and European markets ask for sustainability evidence. We help you answer with certifiable materials and technical datasheets for your packaging.

cta.title: Moving your packaging to paperboard?
cta.desc: We walk the transition with you: structure, materials and costs.
